The current RL1 target consumes gameplay state, collision, damage, hitlag, shield, item, source, identity lanes, and the other fp+0x221F gameplay-adjacent bits, but not camera-box rendering visibility. exception=Only bit 0x80 of the raw compare byte is ignored for validation totals/rollout first-break ranking.
